title: Consecrating Holy Prophet Aluyah during the Biafra war

tellings.quote: And we consecrate him a bishop. He's now bishop, holy prophet allelujah. And the Nigerian embassy is there.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about secret history and the occult, says that around 1968 or 1969 in the Bronx, New York, he took part in consecrating a man known as Holy Prophet Aluyah as a bishop. He says this was during the Biafra war, Nigeria's civil war of that time, and that people from the Nigerian embassy were there, a detail he tells as a strange link between small religious groups and world politics.
